steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Excuse me, I see you've been circling the market for a while now. Are you having trouble finding what you need?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Oh, are you talking to me?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: I am. We're about to close soon, so if you don't leave, you'll have to spend the night here.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But it's not even seven.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Heh, knew you weren't from around these parts. This place is a complete mess at night. Nobody in their right mind would keep their doors open late.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I did happen to arrive just a few days ago. Only settled into an inn around here last night.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: There are so many places you could go to in Lungmen. Why visit our tiny little market?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Just a little habit of mine. Whenever I go to a new place, I like checking out the local market.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: These places are always a good gauge of customs, mannerisms, and local color.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Aren't all markets the same? Noisy as hell, just a bunch of people coming and going?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well, for starters... the market in Shangshu can stay open all night, but not this one here.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: So, were you going to buy something? I'm closing up my stall otherwise.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What would you recommend?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: We're in the dead of summer and it's hot out there. Maybe grab a couple sprigs of wild bamboo shoots and make porridge out of em' to relieve heat and prevent heatstroke.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hmm, maybe next time then. I don't think the icebox in the inn is big enough to hold half-meter bamboo shoots.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Huh... Strange fellow.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Gonna end up going home late because of him...

steps.name: Street Thug
steps.text: Hey, lou sai, isn't it a bit early to be closing up shop?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: (Ugh, can't dodge these scumbags even at this time of day...?)

steps.name: Street Thug
steps.text: You ready to pay up? Don't forget what you owe me from last month.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: B-Business has been slow th-the last few months... I sincerely apologize, but I truly have nothing worthy of your attention...

steps.name: Street Thug
steps.text: Well that's too bad. Get your ass outta here then. Somebody more capable can take your spot.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Hey, wait! What are you doing?!

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Let go of me! D-Don't smash it! Please, give me just a little more time! I promise I'll have the money for you!

steps.name: Street Thug
steps.text: Pah! Too late!
Now, now, my brother. Let's play nice here.

steps.name: Street Thug
steps.text: Huh, who the hell are you, old man?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Old man? My, you do flatter me with that honorific. I'm more than happy to just be brothers.

steps.name: Street Thug
steps.text: I'd watch my tone, if I were you. While you're at it, shouldn't you ask who I'm working for?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Would it be the illustrious Lin family?

steps.name: Street Thug
steps.text: If you know that much, then show some respect.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: (My goodness. Why do eight out of every ten hoodlums I run into in this city say they're working for Lin?)

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Aha, no wonder why you looked a bit familiar. I remember seeing you at the Lin estate.

steps.name: Street Thug
steps.text: Uhh... Y-You know me?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Of course I do. The golden osmanthus flowers were blooming magnificently at Old Lin's place last year, and he made plenty of honeyed osmanthus. Did you also take some home with you?

steps.name: Street Thug
steps.text: O-Of course! Before I left, Old Lin gave me a dozen jars. I couldn't even finish them all.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hmm, oh my... I forgot to mention, Old Lin doesn't grow sweet osmanthus in front of his house. They're peach trees.

steps.name: Street Thug
steps.text: Diu nei ah, do you know Lin or not?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Maybe I do, maybe I don't. But I can say for a fact that you don't.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: If you know what's good for you, beat it. I hear Old Lin's governance is pretty strict. If he knew someone was using his name to do evil, such a man wouldn't get off lightly.

steps.name: Street Thug
steps.text: Bah. Talk about rotten luck.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Err... Sir, thank you very much.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Don't worry about it, it's not like I even lifted a finger. The next time you run into these scoundrels, know that there's nothing to be afraid of. Most of these thugs are just nobodies trying to take advantage of the situation to extort people. There's no way real gangsters would be this brazen.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: *sigh*... I'm just a small-time peddler. How can I tell if someone's a big deal?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Wait, don't go yet.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: The icebox in your inn might be small, but it should fit this bag of lychee just fine.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Planted 'em in my own backyard. They're not worth any money, but they should still taste fine. It's the least I can do.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: ...Sir?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Ahh, I was just thinking, getting to enjoy the wonderful taste of lychee makes the long trek out here worth it.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Hah, I'm glad to hear it. If you enjoy 'em, feel free to come back any time.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Mr. Lee! Hey, Mr. Lee!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well, if it isn't Choi, our honorable vendor. I heard you calling out to me before I even stepped into the market.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: I just don't want you left with bamboo shoots that aren't fresh anymore. The cold season is the perfect time to enjoy these winter shoots.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: There's no way they'd go bad in just a few minutes, is there?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Remember to soak them in salt water once you take them back. That'll make 'em last longer.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Maybe next time. The kitchen in the place I rented only has enough room for a couple produce bags before I have to throw them in the icebox.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: I won't take no for an answer. This is the finest white-eyed bamboo I have. I saved it for you because you're a man of character.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Really, it's alright. I'll have an honored guest over in just a few days. The stuff's not going to keep for very long.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Oh, you've made friends in Lungmen?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Not sure friends is the right word.
Then, what must I do to be considered your friend?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Oh, Mr. Lin, are you here to pick up fresh produce for your wife?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: The wife isn't so picky. She wouldn't send me to a market more than ten kilometers away just to pick up some bamboo shoots.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: (Wait, Mr. Lee... Is, is it really him...?)

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: (Just treat him as you would a regular passerby.)

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: You haven't answered my question yet.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Please, I'm just an ordinary civilian. The man who invites me to a fancy banquet at a nice restaurant is already a bosom friend to me.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: That's not what my men have been telling me. Apparently, you've been in and out of all the small eateries around here this past week.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: If you could've found me at all those other places, why come out to this market so far from home?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: I wouldn't make the trip for a few stalks of bamboo shoots, but for a friend, I'd consider it worthwhile.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You speak too highly of me, Mr. Lin. I just took care of a few odd jobs for you, that's all. Even without me, you would've been able to resolve things just fine.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: I disagree. Had you not been there, I doubt the outcome would've been comparable.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Ah... Mr. Lin, I know exactly how much I'm worth.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: So, how do you plan to cook these bamboo shoots? They're very high-quality.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: A nice and simple braising sounds tasty enough.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Such a pedestrian method is a waste of perfectly good ingredients. If you ask me, it'd be better to slaughter a fowlbeast fresh and make some hearty stew.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Then, you're no longer appreciating the delicate sweetness of the bamboo shoots.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Besides...

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Let's hear it.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hah. Besides, these bamboo shoots came from the countryside. They be of willful temperament. I doubt they'd pair well with other ingredients.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: The biggest concern is that they grow too well. Even deep in the mountains and ancient forests, they'll attract wave after wave of bamboo shoot diggers.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: That being the case, how could they ever hope to live a life of peace and contentment?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Haha, that remains to be seen.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Wei would not visit a man's home for no reason...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I believe.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Believe what?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I believe... that once Master Wei picks up the chopsticks, he won't be able to stop to chat with me.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Hmm... Lou sai, do you sell apples here?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Ah, yes, I certainly do. I'll get them for you right away, Mr. Lin.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: How much?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Ah, um, that won't be necessary. The fact that we've been able to live in peace all these years thanks to you is payment enough.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: It's not easy running a business. Here, take it.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Didn't you say you weren't buying anything?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Since I'm already here, might as well grab something for my daughter.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Aiya, men do change after kids. I wanted to invite you to see the flowers at Jiangqi next year, but I suppose I'll have to give up on the idea.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: I suggest you settle down as well, and leave behind that life of wandering.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Forget it. That isn't the life I'm searching for anyway.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Madam, take a look at this season's greengage. Thin skin, thick flesh, and a tiny core. Tangy and delectably sweet, one bite and you'll be salivating for more.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: If you don't take a few catties back with you today to make wine, you won't be get to experience this flavor after the Qingming Festival passes.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Alright... Weigh some out for me then.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Right away. You know, there's a saying that goes 'green plum wine tastes freshest in season.' ...Hah, I'm not particularly well-read, I just happened to hear that somewhere.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Choi, I hear you buttering up your customers from over here, trying to get into their pockets, eh? You've... become quite the smooth talker.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Oh come on, it's just business.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Do you come here often, Mr. Lee?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Long time no see. What brings you out here today, Madam?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: This is the largest, most comprehensive produce market in Lungmen. Naturally, the best choice whenever you need ingredients.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What kind of ingredients need you coming out here in person?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Well, Yenwu's birthday is coming up, and I'd like to make him a few dishes.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What do you have in mind?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I haven't decided yet, but it wouldn't be anything more than what he normally likes to eat.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm sure Master Wei's preferences... must be quite a test for your culinary skills.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Hardly. What's a little effort if your heart is in the right place?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Fair enough.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: But I'll admit... as this is my first time here, I'm having difficulty picking out what I want. I'd appreciate your advice if you don't mind.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Sure, can do. Take these tomatoes for example. If you want to just eat them as you would a fruit, go with a pink one, which has a crispier texture. If you're cooking with them, opt for the deep red ones, which are juicier and have a stronger taste.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Alright, I'll keep that in mind. They have some taro over there. I'd like to make some taro smoked meat.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Taro, huh? Given tubers of about the same size, go with the heaviest one. That means it has a greater water and starch content, which leads to a soft, glutinous taste.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Great. What about shiitake mushrooms then? Should I go with dried, or fresh?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Both have their advantages, Madam. It all depends on what you want to cook.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Stuffed mushrooms.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Go with dried shiitake in that case, they have greater pungency after soaking.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Oh... I see.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Before I forget, there's a store up ahead that sells soy sauce. It's perfect for making braised fowlbeast.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: (Though, they recently raised their prices.)

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: (You don't need to worry about that, Choi.)

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: For the rose petal and soy sauce glaze?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Mmhmm.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Actually about that... Yenwu does eat this dish often, but only because I'm the one who's quite fond of it.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm aware.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: He's brought it up at the dinner table before. Is it so unusual for his tastes to take after those of his wife?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Pfft... Haha.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: You're a smoother talker than that vendor.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Haha. Speaking of which, I've become a bit of a businessman myself lately.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Haven't you always been easygoing with your finances? From the very beginning, Yenwu repeatedly asked you to take up a very important position in the L.G.D., but you refused each time. Why are you worrying about your livelihood now?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: There's an extra mouth to feed back home now, so I need to run some errands to cover the living expenses.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Hmm? Are you finally starting your own family? Yenwu and I can stop by and offer our congratulations one of these days.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It's more like... Actually, an old friend came from afar and left a child behind in my care.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: How terribly irresponsible... Did he say when he'd be back?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: No... But there's no way he'd just abandon the girl, right? I reckon he'll be back after a few months.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: After I hand the girl back to him, I plan to take a page out of his book and go on a long trip myself.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: What, Lungmen isn't good enough for you?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: No, it certainly is. But, I am a wanderer after all. Can't stay in a single place too long.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: *sigh*... In any case, thanks for your advice, Mr. Lee. I pretty much have everything I need now, so I should get going.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Take it easy, Madam.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Mr. Lee! Psst, Mr. Lee!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Oh... Did you need something, Choi?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: You've been standing here all day, you know? Other people have to shop too.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Sorry about that, haha. How much for the imported cherries?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Didn't you say they were too expensive for you?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Yes, but the kid likes 'em, so I figure I can take a few catties home and give them a try.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: By the way, did the stuff I ordered from you last week come in yet?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Sure did. I have everything ready for you.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: My, I'm sorry. I had some stuff to take care of at home today. Sorry to keep you waiting.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Haha, don't worry about it. It's not even nine yet, and the sun hasn't even set. Too early to close up.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: But, why'd you come here yourself? Couldn't you just send your apprentice over?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: He had work to take care of today. We just moved into the new place, so he went with Waai Fu and Aak to tidy up.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: You moved? Was the old place getting too cramped?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Yup. Didn't have as many rooms as I would've liked, which made it hard to have guests over. Also wanted to add another freezer, but the kitchen was too small.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Are two freezers not enough for you?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: That's what happens when you have multiple mouths to feed. Thankfully, Hung's learned the ropes by now, or I'd keel over dead from all that cooking.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: You know, nobody's gonna shed any tears if none of your other talents get passed down. But, the world can't afford to lose your culinary skills. Having him here is already a huge relief.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: He's only just scratched the surface. He's far from ready.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: So, are you going to cook by yourself today?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Yes indeed. They've been busy all day, and deserve a proper reward.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Haha! Take this potted kumquat with you then. To your new firm's successful opening and continued prosperity.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Oh? Isn't this tree very important to you? You've kept it in the store for years, and never let anyone go around touching it.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The cold season just passed, and it's bearing rich fruit. Why... are you giving it to me now?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: To be honest with you, Lee, I don't plan on keeping this shop open much longer.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Are you moving somewhere else?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: I'm about ready to retire.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It's been more than a decade, huh...

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Almost thirty years, including the time before you started coming.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Just got a notice last month saying that this place is going to be demolished and converted into a supermarket. Though, we'd still be able to preserve the shop.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Too many places have been going down around Lungmen these days... The teahouse near my place also got demolished, and they say it's going to turn into a coffee shop.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Hah, that's exactly it. It's fine though. My wife and I have worked so hard all these years. It's time to rest now.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Your son and daughter have grown up and moved out as well, so there's no point to holding down the fort any longer. Why don't you travel, take in some new sights and sounds?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: We've been in Lungmen all these years, and haven't seen any of Yan's other cities yet.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: The savings we've scrounged up over the years, as well as the compensation from the government, should be enough to give us a few years of good fun.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Lee, you've been all over the place. Got any recommendations for us?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I've pretty much settled down in Lungmen too. Asking me to suddenly think back to my days on the road is no easy task.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But, when I think about it a bit more closely, all the bad things that happened are like dark clouds parting after a storm. What remains most vividly... is pleasant scenery and warm smiles.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: And, a noisy produce market.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hahahaha! You still remember our conversation from back then, huh?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Once I go to Shangshu myself, I'll have to visit that 24/7 produce market as soon as I get the chance.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Good... Very good.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Looking back all these years, every time I saw you, you always said you were going to leave Lungmen. But now, more than ten years later, turns out I'll be the one who's leaving.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: That's right. Every time I tried to leave, there would always be some happy little accident tying me down.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Anyway... Choi, a lot of people come to me before setting off on their trips, asking me to read their fortunes.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: We've been old friends for so many years now, so I don't mind giving you a free reading today. Want me to tell you how your journey's going to go?

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Haha, sure.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: What does it say?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: This is the Shih-Wang hexagram, which is a symbol of great auspice. On this journey, you will enjoy smooth travels, fair weather, and good health.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: Hahaha, you really know how to say what people want to hear.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm not trying to butter you up, Choi. This is my heartfelt desire. That fate... will bring us together again in the future.

steps.name: Produce Vendor
steps.text: ...May fate bring us together again.

steps.name: Supermarket Broadcast
steps.text: Winter's almost here! That's right, winter's almost here! That means we're offering great deals here at the supermarket–buy one get one free on certain selections of fresh meat! Winter's almost here! That's right, winter's almost here! That means we're offering great deals here at the supermarket–buy one get one free on...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: How long have we been standing in line, Hung? Is this ever going to end?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Just a bit longer. There's a big sale at the supermarket today, so a lot more people showed up than usual.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: All over a piece of meat? My legs are gonna fall off from all this standing. I don't even get this tired from holding my martial arts poses.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: A few days ago, Mr. Lee went out of his way to order braised leg meat in scallion oil, saying he wanted to eat it over his birthday. Luckily, they're selling that meat fresh at the supermarket today. Wait a few days longer and we'd only be able to get our hands on the frozen stuff.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I swear, the older he gets, the more childish he becomes. Whenever he wants to eat something, he has to have it then and there.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Well, birthdays are when your dreams are supposed to come true.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: You say all that, but weren't you the one who picked out a present well in advance and hid it in your room?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: H-How'd you find out? Didn't I say I can clean my room just fine by myself?!

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: I didn't go into your room... I just happened to see a bin filled with wrapping paper when I went to take out the trash.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Argh, I didn't think it'd be so hard to wrap up a present either! Had to wrap it and unwrap it so many times before I finally managed to fold it flat.

steps.name: Supermarket Worker
steps.text: What would you like to get, Sir?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: A cut of leg meat, please.

steps.name: Supermarket Worker
steps.text: Front or rear?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Rear.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Waai Fu, have you seen Aak? Why isn't he here yet? We need to head back after picking up the meat.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: No clue. He disappeared as soon as we went inside.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: (Looks all around) Ugh...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Oh, isn't that him right there? He's walking toward us.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Where've you been all this time? And what did you buy?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Nothing. Just window shopping for something I could pick up for Old Lee.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Didn't see anything you liked?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Hehe, nope.

steps.name: Cashier
steps.text: That'll be a total of 471 LMD. Will you be paying cash or card?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Excuse me, Miss... I think you did the math wrong.

steps.name: Cashier
steps.text: Huh? We calculate everything by machine. There's no way it would be wrong.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: (Strange, how is more expensive than what I calculated?)

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Waai Fu, mind opening the bag up for me? Let me add things up again.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Don't worry about it, Hung. You might've made a little slip-up. Let's hurry up and head home with our stuff first.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Yeah, that's right. We've been out all day, and I'm sure Waai Fu here is tired. Let's go home and get some rest.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Waai Fu, open the bag.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Here you go, Hung. Comb through everything carefully.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: (Oops, should've kept my mouth shut...)

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Leg meat, white radishes, pumpkin, lotus root...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Umm, Hung, there seems to be a pouch of herbs at the bottom of the bag.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Aah... Achoo! *cough* *cough*... What the heck is this stuff? It stings!

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *wheeze*... What is this?!

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Huh? What are you two lookin' at me for? Nobody ever said you had to open it up.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: If anything, the stuff the two of you are gettin' for Lee is way too boring.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Anyway, I'll head back first. The two of you can catch up later.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *cough*... Why you little...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Get back here, you little!
